description: This file defines a shell script for scheduling device reboots using cron based on firmware maintenance windows, with logic to calculate random reboot times within configured windows and avoid conflicts with ongoing operations.

methods.name: calcRebootExecTime
methods.description: Calculates a random reboot time within the maintenance window considering device time offset and other parameters.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules the reboot cron job by updating the crontab with the computed reboot time.
